steps: Since the image is real and 4 times enlarged, magnification m = -4.
Using m = v/u, we get v = -4 * (-12.5 cm) = 50 cm.
The equivalent focal length of the combination is F = 10 cm = 0.1 m.
The equivalent optical power is P_eq = 1/F = 1/0.1 = 10 D.
For two identical lenses in contact, P_eq = 2P, so the power of each lens is P = 10 / 2 = 5 D.
